limitations: Full descriptions were parsed and hashed for every entry; selected suspect descriptions were read individually. This is not 5,000 individual watched/listened playthroughs.
Structural signatures exclude delay, scale, tint, decorative angles, IDs and labels; related tiers/base weapons may correctly share the same Strike.
Audio meanings use installed provider keys/filenames and native rules; playable duration and loudness are probed when --probe-audio is used. Timbre is not proven by filename.
Free geometry/key coverage is distinct from installed exact video-path availability; this audit does not claim a missing Free pack is installed.
Weapon contact-start timing is authored cosmetic alignment; exact visible contact frames remain media-specific.
